intelligence.essence: The walkthrough asks the right questions. Project Intelligence structures the answers. The Smart Factory holds the templates. The builder fills them and launches. A new citizen walks in, answers 11 steps, and walks out with a personal page, business page, and space — covers auto-picked from their words — live in their Dashboard and Hub. Free world, built automatically.
intelligence.human_view:
1. **Walkthrough (11 steps):** 10 questions capture vision, mission, goal, motto, what they do, what they offer, who they are — plus Step 11 names their world (personal/business/space titles + URL slugs).
2. **Project Intelligence:** `completeWalk()` formats every answer into PI page records (personal/business/space) with vision, mission, goal, sections. Saved to localStorage + POSTed to the PI store per alias.
3. **Smart Covers:** auto-picked from the 50-cover library by keyword-matching their vision/mission/goal text. Each page gets its own cover.
4. **Smart Factory:** holds the finished page templates (personal, business, space at 10/10). The builder fills templates with PI content — never invents, only fills.
5. **Doors:** user lands in Dashboard; pages appear in Hub sidebar + smart bars. Auto-match syncs them with relevant people and content.
intelligence.simple_view: A new person answers a few friendly questions, and — poof — their own pages appear: a personal page, a business page, and a space, with pretty covers the system picked to match their words. They didn't have to build anything; they just answered questions.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it's like telling a good seamstress what you dream of, and she sews the whole dress for you — measured, fitted, finished. You answer some questions about your life and your work, and the system builds your pages for you, covers and all, and hangs them in your wardrobe ready to wear.
intelligence.naya_view: My pipeline is: walkthrough answers → Project Intelligence records → Smart Covers picked by keyword match → Factory templates filled, never invented → doors live in the citizen's Dashboard and Hub. I fill; I do not fabricate. Every walkthrough also teaches the Factory — new answers, new patterns, better auto-picks.
intelligence.ai_view: This is the One Flow fulfilled: "smart note this" → live, but for onboarding. No signup friction, no blank pages, no "now what." They give us their intent in plain words; the machine builds their world. The more they want — more pages, more notes, memberships, deeper automation — the higher the tier: free NayaNET, Power, Pro, Max.

machine_view.title: The Auto-Builder Machine: Walkthrough → PI → Factory → Live Pages
machine_view.machine_section: Pipeline: completeWalk() → PI page records (personal/business/space: vision, mission, goal, sections) → localStorage + POST /api/pi per alias → covers via /api/covers/pick (50-cover R2 library, keyword match on vision/mission/goal) → templates (nayanet.app/personal|business|space) filled → surfaced in Dashboard + Hub sidebar/smart bars → auto-match sync. Tiers: free / Power / Pro / Max gate depth of automation.
